title: Structured negotiation preparation
description: Maps interests, BATNAs, constraints, concessions, and negotiation scenarios before a discussion.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: structured-negotiation-prep
  title: Structured negotiation preparation
  description: Maps interests, BATNAs, constraints, concessions, and negotiation scenarios before a discussion.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Prepare a principled, evidence-based negotiation strategy.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - negotiation-lead
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Negotiation context and objectives
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - parties
          - objectives
          - constraints
          - facts
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: interests
      kind: agent
      name: Map interests and positions
      role: Negotiation strategist
      prompt: Separate stated positions from underlying interests for all parties. Identify shared interests and likely
        friction points.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - communication
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: batna
      kind: agent
      name: Analyze BATNA and leverage
      role: Negotiation analyst
      prompt: Define BATNA, reservation points, alternatives, uncertainty, leverage, and information gaps for each side.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: playbook
      kind: agent
      name: Create negotiation playbook
      role: Lead negotiator
      prompt: Create opening, agenda, questions, trade packages, concessions, walk-away criteria, and contingency scenarios.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: negotiation-lead
      kind: approval
      name: Negotiation lead approves strategy
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Negotiation brief and scenario playbook
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: interests
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: batna
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: interests
      to: playbook
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: batna
      to: playbook
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: playbook
      to: negotiation-lead
      kind: dependency
    - id: e6
      from: negotiation-lead
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
